final: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_records FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT SUM(test_records) AS total_records, AVG(test_records) AS average_per_sex FROM counts) SELECT c.sex, c.test_records, 1.0 * c.test_records / t.total_records AS share_of_total, c.test_records - t.average_per_sex AS above_average FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE c.test_records > t.average_per_sex
